# Operations Cash Management and Teller Performance Review

This document details critical operational tasks related to cash management and performance monitoring within the Operations department.

## Key Operational Tasks:

*   Investigate branch efficiency based on audit findings.
*   Monitor teller performance quarterly.
*   Review teller performance urgently.
*   Review cash flow quarterly.
*   Investigate cash flow standard updates.
